preconditions.description: The road width n is an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The number of safety islands m is between 2 and min(n+1, 10000) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(d) == m and all(0 <= x <= n for x in d) and len(set(d)) == m
preconditions.description: The list d contains m distinct integers representing safety island coordinates, all within [0, n].

preconditions.expression: 0 in d and n in d
preconditions.description: The safety islands list includes both the start (0) and the end (n) of the road.
The green light duration g and red light duration r are integers between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output_str, str) and (output_str == '-1' or (output_str.isdigit() and int(output_str) >= 0))
postconditions.description: The output is either the string '-1' indicating impossibility, or a non-negative integer string representing the minimum time.

postconditions.expression: output_str == '-1' if not any_valid_path_exists(n, d, g, r) else str(min_time_to_reach_n(n, d, g, r))
postconditions.description: If no valid path exists that satisfies all movement and traffic light constraints, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum time required to reach coordinate n.
